violations.finding: XRP ETF flow divergence resolution: 'Data wins over the behavioral interpretation because both data points are from the same primary source (coinglass) and neither can be dismissed. The weekly positive flow is the longer timeframe and per LZ-MR-001 is more significant'

LZ-EH-005 requires that equal-weight contradictions be flagged, not resolved. The weekly and daily data are from the same source and same instrument — neither has higher evidentiary weight. LZ-MR-001 (cross-timeframe confirmation) applies when a trend is confirmed across timeframes, not when timeframes contradict. Contradicting timeframes are precisely the opposite of cross-timeframe confirmation. Using LZ-MR-001 to partially resolve an LZ-EH-005 contradiction is a misapplication of the rule.

The self-challenge is useful but the specific reasoning embeds an unexamined causal assumption. This is minor because it is presented as a challenge rather than a conclusion.
